Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The area of the Reservoir west of Lee Bridge
• The course of the River Lee from W 250 667 to W 314 709
• The entire area of land above 200 metres at Cill na Martra
• The entire area of coniferous plantation at W 25 66.

criteria.label: The area of the Reservoir west of Lee Bridge
The course of the River Lee from W 250 667 to W 314 709

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The entire course of the Drumcliff River
• Two named lakes
• The entire area of land above 300 metres south of northing 43.

criteria.label: The entire course of the Drumcliff River
The entire area of land above 300 metres south of northing 43.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm].
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• If there is no attempt to draw the coastline, deduct 2 marks from the total mark.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The course of the River Suir from S 132 728 to S 119 680
• The entire area of land above 200 metres
• The entire area of Templemore Lake
• The entire route of the railway line.

criteria.label: The course of the River Suir from S 132 728 to S 119 680
The entire area of land above 200 metres
The entire area of Templemore Lake
The entire route of the railway line.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 11.95 cm x 8.95 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm].
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:

• A feature of coastal deposition
• The entire route of the waymarked walk named the Glenart Walk

criteria.label: The entire course of the Avoca River
The entire route of the waymarked walk named the Glenart Walk
The entire area of land above 200 metres at Ballydonnell in the north of the map.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale. Required size is 12cm x 9cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm]. The sketch must have four sides drawn.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow naming marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• If there is no attempt to draw the coastline, deduct 2 marks from the total mark.
• Sketch may be on lined paper or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The entire area of Lough Cullin
• The course of the River Moy between G 259 024 and G 269 090
• Mark an X at the confluence of the River Moy and the Yellow River
• The entire area of land above 200 metres.

criteria.label: The entire area of Lough Cullin
The course of the River Moy between G 259 024 and G 269 090
Mark an X at the confluence of the River Moy and the Yellow River
The entire area of land above 200 metres.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm].
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

• Do not accept European or Continental / Sub-Continental region.

• Credit additional relevant information on the sketch map for a further 1 x SRP. This must be information not already awarded in the written account.
• Positive and negative interpretation of development is acceptable.
• Max 1 x SRP’s per factor if merely a description of the factor with no reference to the development of secondary economic activity.
• Max 7 x SRP’s if only one factor explained.

cards.stem: Aerial Photograph
cards.questionText:
Examine the aerial photograph of Foxford accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the aerial photograph, half the length and half the breadth. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The river
• Two connecting streets
• An industrial building
• An area of waste ground in the right background.

criteria.label: An area of waste ground in the right background.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn half the length and half the breadth. The measurements required are 12.7 cm by 8.3 cm [allow 0.5 cm difference on each side].
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using edge of the page not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the aerial photograph is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If Ordnance Survey map is used instead of aerial photograph 0 marks.
• The features must be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The entire course of the River Suir
• An area of land over 400m
• The Waterford Cycling Trails cycle route from S 148 180 to S 200 218
• An area of coniferous plantation north of Northing 24 and west of Easting 17.

criteria.label: The entire course of the River Suir
The Waterford Cycling Trails cycle route from S 148 180 to S 200 218
An area of coniferous plantation north of Northing 24 and west of Easting 17.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm].
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The entire route of the N24
• The entire route of the railway line
• A post office
• A car park.

criteria.label: The entire route of the N24
The entire route of the railway line

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm].
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Aerial Photograph

Examine the aerial photograph of Clonmel accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the aerial photograph, half the length and half the breadth. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:

• An area of recreational land-use
• An area of ecclesiastical land-use
• An area of residential land-use.
directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn half the length and half the breadth. The measurements required are 12.7 cm by 8.3 cm (allow 0.5 cm difference on each side).
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using edge of the page not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the aerial photograph is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If Ordnance Survey map is used instead of aerial photograph 0 marks.
• The features must be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The entire area of Lisnananagh Lough
• The course of the Stradone River from where it exits Lisnananagh Lough to H 505 056.
• The triangulation pillar at Fleming’s Folly in the south west of the map
• The entire area of land above 300 metres.

criteria.label: The entire area of Lisnananagh Lough
The course of the Stradone River from where it exits Lisnananagh Lough to H 505 056.
The triangulation pillar at Fleming’s Folly in the south west of the map
The entire area of land above 300 metres.

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm]. It must be landscape orientation.
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The coastline
• The 18 hole golf course, north of Bantry town
• The entire area of Lough Bofinna
• The entire area of land above 400 metres at Mullaghmesha.

criteria.label: The 18 hole golf course, north of Bantry town
The entire area of Lough Bofinna
The entire area of land above 400 metres at Mullaghmesha

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm]. It must be landscape orientation.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The entire area of Lough Corrib
• The course of the Owenriff river from M 089 417 to where it enters Lough Corrib
• Buffy Lough
• The entire route of the N59 road.

criteria.label: The entire area of Lough Corrib
The course of the Owenriff river from M 089 417 to where it enters Lough Corrib
The entire route of the N59 road

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm]. It must be landscape orientation.
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Isostasy
cards.questionText: Describe and explain how isostasy has shaped the Irish landscape.
directions: • Credit 1 x SRP for a second impact/feature identified from description/explanation. All further impacts/features require description/explanation.
• Credit 2 x SRPs for two named Irish examples from description/explanation.
• Credit 1 x SRP for relevant labelled diagram from description/explanation. Diagram without labelling 0 marks.
• Credit 2 x SRPs for additional relevant information on a labelled diagram from description/explanation. This must be information not already awarded in the written account.
• Accept features of coastal emergence and features of rejuvenation.
• Question is tied to Ireland.
• Max 2 x SRPs if there is merely a description of isostasy without a reference to the impact on the Irish landscape.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The golf course
• The viewpoint
• The cycle route in the north west of the map
• An area of forestry south of northing 40.

criteria.label: The cycle route in the north west of the map
An area of forestry south of northing 40

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm]. It must be landscape orientation.
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Aerial Photograph
cards.questionText:
Examine the aerial photograph of Oughterard accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the aerial photograph, half the length and half the breadth. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• A sports field
• A bridge
• A church
• A housing estate in the foreground.

criteria.label: A housing estate in the foreground

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn half the length and half the breadth. The measurements required are 12.7 cm by 8.3 cm (allow 0.5 cm difference on each side). It must be of landscape orientation.
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using edge of the page not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the aerial photograph is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If Ordnance Survey map is used instead of aerial photograph 0 marks.
• The features must be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Ordnance Survey Map
cards.questionText:
Examine the 1:50 000 Ordnance Survey map and legend accompanying this paper. Draw a sketch map of the area shown to half scale. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The coastline
• The railway line
• The wind farm south of Dundalk town
• The entire area of land above 300 metres.

criteria.label: The wind farm south of Dundalk town
The entire area of land above 300 metres

directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn to half scale of the prescribed area. Required size is 12 cm x 9 cm [allow a difference of up to 0.5cm]. It must be landscape orientation.
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using the edge of the page is not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the map is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If the aerial photograph is used instead of the Ordnance Survey map 0 marks.
• The features may be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.

cards.stem: Aerial Photograph
cards.questionText:
Examine the aerial photograph of Dundalk accompanying the paper. Draw a sketch map of the aerial photograph, half the length and half the breadth. On it, correctly show and label each of the following:
• The river
• The railway line
• An area of residential land-use
• An area of recreational land-use.
directions: • Sketch outline must be drawn half the length and half the breadth. The measurements required are 12.7 cm by 8.4 cm (allow 0.5 cm difference on each side). It must be of landscape orientation.
• The sketch must have four sides drawn. Using edge of the page not acceptable. Lose 4 marks for sketch outline.
• If sketch is traced or only a section of the aerial photograph is drawn, lose 4 marks for sketch outline and lose 3 marks for showing per item. Allow labelling marks only.
• If Ordnance Survey map is used instead of aerial photograph 0 marks.
• The features must be labelled on the sketch or in a key. If not labelled, 0 marks for showing.

• There must be an attempt to show feature for labelling marks to be awarded. If not shown, 0 marks for labelling. If located incorrectly but labelled correctly, labelling marks can be awarded as there has been an attempt to locate it.
• Showing marks graded 3/1/0. Reasonable accuracy (location and proportion) for full showing marks.
• Sketch may be drawn in the answer book or on graph paper.
